briefings.title: Mark Pincus unpacks his "Proven, Better, New" framework (with Reid Hoffman) | Masters of Scale
briefings.tldr: To build successful consumer products, entrepreneurs must isolate innovation using the "Proven, Better, New" framework, ruthlessly test ideas to build a "failure machine," and prepare for a highly democratized consumer AI era where taste and rapid iteration supersede traditional development cycles.

briefings.title: Zynga Founder: Consumer Is Not Investible Right Now - Thats Why You Should Build It
briefings.tldr: While current investor sentiment heavily favors enterprise software, the impending exponential drop in AI inference costs will unleash a massive consumer tech revolution, paving the way for trillion-dollar "internet treasures" built by founders who maintain "founder mode" and use structured product frameworks.

briefings.title: Mark Pincus: How to Spot a Fake CEO
briefings.tldr: Zynga founder Mark Pincus outlines the frameworks required to build enduring consumer products, emphasizing the importance of separating winning instincts from mediocre execution, utilizing "founder mode" to maintain intellectual honesty, and training "technical assistants" to scale a founder's decision-making style.
